title: Why GTA VI’s version of Florida feels so real
summary: There are plenty of reasons why Grand Theft Auto VI is so popular: the 13 years of anticipation, the relatable lead characters and romantic storyline, the sheer level of depth. But another major factor is the sense of place. The GTA series is unmatched when it comes to re-creating the feeling of a bustling, real-world […]
content: There are plenty of reasons why Grand Theft Auto VI is so popular : the 13 years of anticipation , the relatable lead characters and romantic storyline , the sheer level of depth . But another major factor is the sense of place. The GTA series is unmatched when it comes to re-creating the feeling of a bustling, real-world city, and GTA VI 's fictional rendition of Florida is the studio's most lifelike setting yet. It has functioning buses and trains, plentiful buildings you can go into and explore, residents you can chat with, and huge areas where you can interact with wildlife far away from the bright lights of the Miami-like Vice City. title: Here’s where you can save (a little) on the Ocarina of Time remake
summary: A lot of people have The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the Nintendo Switch 2 on their holiday wishlist. In case you haven’t bought it yet, I wanted to share some small but welcome deals happening on the physical and digital versions of the game. Costco members can currently grab the cartridge edition […]
content: The Nintendo Switch 2 remake delivers a complete graphical overhaul and numerous quality-of-life updates to the ‘98 classic. | Image: Nintendo A lot of people have The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the Nintendo Switch 2 on their holiday wishlist. In case you haven’t bought it yet, I wanted to share some small but welcome deals happening on the physical and digital versions of the game. Costco members can currently grab the cartridge edition for $62.99, down from its regular price of $69.99 (it’s the only retailer currently discounting the physical version). Both Amazon and Costco are also selling the digital version for $54.99, a small $5 discount. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Where to Buy: $59.99 $54.99 at Amazon (Digital) $69.99 $62.99 at Costco (Physical) Ocarina of Time is one of Nintendo’s most groundbreaking titles, having served as its first 3D Zelda game when it launched in 1998. Parts of the original game haven’t aged particularly well — namely some dungeon design and the game’s tricky 3D navigation, since there was only one analog stick at the time — which makes it tough for some to enjoy going back to play the N64 version. Thankfully, the Switch 2 remake introduces several fixes, a host of quality-of-life improvements, and, of course, some lovely visuals that make it a graphics powerhouse by today’s standards. If you go the digital route, a recent Switch 2 update lets you gift games to players in your family group. It doesn’t have to be your actual family, either, just up to eight people you designate as part of your group. The digital game will then appear gift-wrapped on their homescreen. Read our full Ocarina of Time review .

content: X is finally rolling out parental controls that allow parents and guardians to manage teens' accounts on the platform. While teens will retain ownership of their own account, parents and guardians will be able to see how much time their child has spent on X, set daily limits, require approval for new followers, and limit For You recommendations to accounts a teen already follows. content: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to prevent Character.AI from selling off user data as it navigates Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings. In a deluge of nearly identical press releases, the various AGs accuse the company of planning to auction off "the private chat histories of more than 21 million U.S. accounts - more than 2.1 million of them registered to minors - with no safeguards for the people whose conversations are being sold." In October, Character.AI filed for bankruptcy following years of scandals and legal challenges , including from Disney . content: Samsung’s premium RGB LED TV has the widest color gamut I’ve measured this year. RGB LED TVs finally became affordable in 2026, and there's always a lot of promise when new TV technologies come out. More color, higher brightness, improved performance - RGB LED TVs have a lot to prove. The Samsung R95H does a lot to deliver some of those promises. It can display more colors than other TVs I've seen so far this year, and the combination of light output and its matte screen makes it great for a bright room. RGB LED TVs might still be in their infancy, but the R95H is a solid TV that shows off the benefits of the new backlight tech. content: Most people know not to try to pass highway patrol cars while performing a traffic break on a freeway. But on November 6th, a driverless Waymo on Interstate 280 failed that test.
